title: Intergenerational mobility in Latin America: the multiple facets of social status and the role of mothers
core_idea: Assess intergenerational mobility in education and income rank in five Latin American countries (Brazil, Chile, Ecuador, Mexico, Panama) by incorporating both parents' education and occupation as proxies for family socioeconomic background, and evaluate how the informativeness of these proxies varies across countries and over time with attention to the role of mothers.
tldr: The paper aims to measure intergenerational mobility across five Latin American countries using parental education and occupation together as family background proxies, and to document cross-country and temporal variation in how informative those proxies are, with a focus on maternal contributions.
